profile.summary: UC Berkeley is the flagship campus of the University of California, a public university founded in 1868. It offers undergraduate and graduate education across many academic departments and programs, conducts research, and maintains libraries and museums.

sources.title: OUSD and UC Berkeley expand partnership

review.notes: UC Berkeley in Berkeley, CA matches the agenda vendor for a data sharing agreement with OUSD's Research, Assessment and Data department, and the berkeley.edu footer shows UC Regents; website and phone (campus operator 510-642-6000) are confirmed. The cited About page does not say 'public university' or 'flagship campus', and its 1868 date is for the University of California as a whole, so summary and orgType are not supported by the cited sources.
